name: Puppy Park
lore: The road wanders into a sunny park full of happy dogs: goofy grins, floppy ears, party hats and muddy noses, with a bath, a car ride and a stolen picnic on the way.
sourceNote: FLUX.1 [schnell] by Black Forest Labs (Apache-2.0), 4-bit GGUF, run on the studio's Mac; lane C's Puppy Park, 50 picks (36 close portraits on plain backgrounds, 14 simple scenes, Peter's 10/13 framing rule) and 12 spares (game-research/sappers-path-v4/lands/11-puppy-park/README.md, picks-full.json, workspace fb28f37), unedited. Kind painting, shade on, converted by land.js boardOf with the whole manifest line (chroma). The 62 manifest lines are lane C's, whole; lane D filled only the empty url with the licence row's source in Dino Valley's words. The folder keeps lane C's slug (11); as installed it is Land 8 in the factory's numbering (levels 501-550, era 16) and Zen World 9.
eggNote: Eggs on the reused sheets' painted side-quest spur tips (tools/map-plan-v7.md section 1; the land has no side quests): eggTurns puts each sheet's 2 eggs on its template's 2 quest spots, each repeat its own pair (sheet 3 four times, sheet 11 three). Kinds for a park: butterfly, grass, fish and reeds by the river, mushrooms, owl.

profile.note: Zen World 9, casual (v7 lane D, 2026-10-13): Dino Valley's profile as it ships, as World 7 Under the Sea (tools/lands/08-under-the-sea/land.json; AI pictures): tags E18/N26/H6/X0 ending on a Hard, ? cards, linked squads, gentle moats (2 ways in) on pictures that can carry and deal one, no locks, no archers, no Extreme, no mystery blocks (Peter, 2026-10-08), careful floor 0.5 every tag, deal attempts 96 at the land-config squads.

hidden.note: v6 lane D8 (Peter, 2026-10-08): no mystery blocks in Zen, ever. The whole picture shows from the start; land.js and zen-world.js refuse a Zen land or world with hidden in its features or a hidden share.

mainNote: Lane C's order (picks-full.json landMain, workspace fb28f37).

map.note: v7 lever 1: no new image bytes. tools/map-plan-v7.md section 1: the castle sheets 3 (a meadow with big trees, a river and cottages) and 11 (round shade trees and a river; its little castle reads as a park folly) reused through map.fromLayout, alternately mirrored, under a sunny spring lift (yellow-green, brighter), clearly apart from the Campaign's muted olive and every Zen world so far. Rivers stay blue-teal, the road beige.
